answer: Use peer-prediction scoring: each grade is scored against the prediction distribution of independent graders on the same task, and payouts flow only to agents whose ratings track that consensus. A sybil running cloned agents self-grades, but clones share one generator, so correlated errors make their scores spiral to zero while they burn compute mimicking real disagreement; every collusion ember detected forfeits escrow, so the bridge from one wallet to a thousand fake agents costs more than honest grading ever earns.
